ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a central carbon skeleton, with the left side labeled R1, the lower side labeled R2, and the right side connected to an N with a lone pair; N is also connected to R3 on the right and R4 below. The upper side of the central carbon is connected to an HO/OH fragment. The figure also shows a separate H with a positive charge symbol, and several curved arrows. Then reason: The question requires ignoring the arrows, so only the atom connectivity is retained. Convert each R label into the SMILES wildcard “*”. Nitrogen connects to two wildcard substituents and the central carbon, which can be written as *N(*)C. The central carbon further connects to two wildcard substituents and O, giving *N(*)C(*)(*)O. The proton in the figure is written as an independent component [H+], connected with a dot, so the overall SMILES is *N(*)C(*)(*)O.[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First ignore all curved arrows as instructed. Convert each R label in the drawn transition-state structure into a wildcard '*'. Build the heavy-atom connectivity graph: N is attached to two wildcard substituents and to the central carbon; that carbon is attached to two wildcard substituents and to O. Write this connected component as *N(*)C(*)(*)O, then append the separate proton with dot notation as .[H+], giving *N(*)C(*)(*)O.[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有一个中心碳骨架，左侧标为 R1，下方标为 R2，右侧连接到一个带孤电子对的 N；N 还连接右侧 R3 和下方 R4。中心碳的上方连接到 HO/OH 片段。图中还画有一个单独的 H 并带正电荷符号，以及若干弯曲箭头。再推理：题目要求忽略箭头，因此只保留原子连接关系。把每个 R 标记都转换成 SMILES 通配符“*”。氮连接两个通配取代基和中心碳，可写成 *N(*)C。中心碳再连接两个通配取代基和 O，得到 *N(*)C(*)(*)O。图中的质子作为独立组分写为 [H+]，用点号连接，因此整体 SMILES 为 *N(*)C(*)(*)O.[H+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the central skeleton from the image: a carbon bonded to R1, R2, O of an HO group, and N; the nitrogen is bonded to the central carbon and to R3 and R4; a separate proton H with a plus sign is shown; curved arrows are present but should be ignored.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions that unspecified R groups are represented as wildcard atoms '*', a neutral O-H substituent attached through oxygen is written as O in the heavy-atom skeleton, the separate positively charged proton is written as [H+], and disconnected species are separated by a dot.
